answer: The garden lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the cipher is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, diluted when peers disagree, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. By the shale of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
